notes: Theory/lattice-simulation paper. It computes axion production from a network of axionic cosmic strings with realistic high string tension, and combines with a lattice determination of the hot-QCD topological susceptibility to predict the dark-matter axion mass m_a = 26.2 +/- 3.4 microeV under the assumption that the axion makes up 100% of dark matter (post-inflationary/PQ-restored scenario). This is a prediction of the QCD-axion mass, not an experimental or observational exclusion limit on any of the tabulated couplings (no g_agamma, g_ae, g_an, etc. bound is derived). Hence is_new_limit=false, no data points. It is also not a sensitivity projection of an experiment (is_projection=false).
